listing.name: Fleet Accounting
listing.summary: Do you like playing with Second-in-Command? Good. Do you struggle to count up to whatever number of Atlases you are casually fielding in your fleet? Me too. Then this mod is for you (and me, I guess).
listing.aiSummary: Enables fleet composition statistics in LunaLib settings regardless of skills and adds civilian ships to the list.

description: Allows all fleet composition data statistics to be enabled in LunaLib settings, showing them even without relevant skills. It also adds civilian ships to the fleet composition list.
